provider.note: The actual CI provider/runner and the source of the protected policy are unprovided inputs; required-check names must be registered by the repo admin before anything is configured. Nothing is invented here.

binding.description: Every required check's evidence must be bound to the exact integration merge SHA of the candidate; a new head/mergeSHA must never reuse an older check's evidence (STALE_EVIDENCE blocks promotion).

requiredChecks.evidenceRule: Protected-check history is preserved; after a restore, old evidence can never authorize a new SHA (infra/delivery/platform/artifact-retention.json#rollbackRetention).

authorization.writerOwner: Platform policy writes belong to the existing P tasks and the Comet closeout authorization; the real P4_1 gate stays with the platform.
authorization.basis: infrastructure-plan.md I06: this stage is design/read-only verification only; the admin identity is not this run approval to modify branch protection, so configuring required checks must be refused.
